org.name: AIKIZI
org.one_liner: Upload any image and decode its complete creative DNA — style lineage, mood signature, composition blueprint, and a production-ready AI prompt. 120+ visual attributes analyzed in seconds. Free to start.

facts.claim: AIKIZI is a tool that reverse-engineers any image into AI prompts and functions as a Style DNA Decoder.
The service allows users to upload any image and decode its creative DNA, including style lineage, mood signature, composition blueprint, and a production-ready AI prompt.
AIKIZI analyzes 120+ visual attributes in seconds.

voice_rules: Emphasize a decode-first narrative over standard text-to-image generation tools.
Adopt the user-centric mindset: 'You're not a prompt engineer. You're a creator.'
Focus on solving the prompt engineering struggle: 'You know great work when you see it. Describing it to AI? That's the hard part.'
Highlight the simplicity and immediacy of the solution using phrases like 'Zero prompts needed' and 'Style DNA -- decoded in seconds.'
Consistently use proprietary terminology such as 'Style DNA', 'Blueprints', 'Weaves', 'Decode', and 'Realms'.
Use highly technical, analytical creative phrasing (e.g., 'reverse-engineer', 'creative DNA', 'style lineage', 'mood signature', 'composition blueprint').
Maintain a precise, direct, and capability-focused tone.
brand_rules: The primary tagline of the product must always be 'Decode Any Media'.
The hero subtitle must be 'Images. Video. Audio. Style DNA -- decoded in seconds.'
Key copy must reference the analytical capabilities: '120+ attributes extracted. 7 analysis layers. 4 media types. Zero prompts needed.'
Target messaging must focus on creative professionals (designers, photographers, artists, directors, concept artists), content creators, and prompt-weary AI enthusiasts.
All email communications must flow from 'AIKIZI <hello@aikizi.com>' or 'AIKIZI Blog <hello@newsletter.aikizi.com>' depending on the context.
Position the product as a 'Style DNA Decoder' that translates images into production-ready AI prompts.
Highlight the analysis of '120+ visual attributes' and speed ('in seconds') as key selling points.
Promote the entry offer as 'Free to start'.
